sections.heading: Intro & Hook
sections.text: Stop the weekly scramble. PlanPilot's weekly content planning template turns chaotic scheduling into a simple routine. In just three steps, you'll have your whole month mapped out.

sections.heading: Step 1 — Define Your Theme Week
sections.text: First, pick a theme for your week. Instead of scrolling through ideas, choose one clear focus—like 'behind-the-scenes' or 'tutorial Tuesday.' This gives your audience something consistent and makes planning much easier.

sections.heading: Step 2 — Map Specific Days
sections.text: Next, block out your week day by day. Assign each day a specific post type and deadline. Seeing your content spread across the week prevents last-minute rushes and keeps your feed balanced.

sections.heading: Step 3 — Reserve Creation Time
sections.text: Finally, schedule dedicated creation blocks. PlanPilot helps you protect those slots so you actually make content instead of waiting for inspiration. Consistency beats perfection every time.

sections.heading: Outro & CTA
sections.text: Start using PlanPilot today and turn your weekly chaos into a smooth workflow. Your content calendar doesn't have to be a nightmare. Three actionable steps to begin now. Keep creating!
